caption: The drawing depicts an interior room with pastel colors, primarily light blue, soft pink, beige, and brown. The walls are decorated with light blue wooden panels and moldings, including a prominent section with an arched glass-fronted cabinet or bookcase on the left, featuring multiple window-like panes and a cupboard below. In the center, there is a large fireplace with a light blue mantle and framing; the fireplace surround is filled with pale pink patterned tiles. Inside the fireplace, there is a brass or gold-colored kettle hanging above metal supports, and a small three-legged metal stand or stool on the hearth in front of it. To the left of the cabinet is a wooden bench with a backrest, colored brown. On the right side of the drawing is a large window with several panes, framed by long, patterned drapes in blue and tan; there is also a matching valance above the window. The floor is a muted brown color, resembling wood or carpet, and the walls and ceiling are painted a pale yellow. The composition is symmetrical around the fireplace, with architectural detail emphasized by fine lines and careful shading.
title: Interior
